body:
Interestingly, with @vvo's [solution](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1049#issuecomment-222927757), if you try and `display: none` the container (in `hidePaginationContainer()`), it wont work. Presumably because something else (`autoHideContainer`?) is resetting the display prop after.

Update:
Indeed, it is `autoHideContainer: true` (the default) that was interfering.
